interface.intro: Menu and values directly from the controller. Changes are confirmed only by a fresh read from TECH.
interface.empty: No items yet. The controller sends them gradually.
interface.help: Numeric editors use raw protocol values. Complex schedules, curves and actions without a verified write format are read-only, with original data available. Loading the entire menu can take several minutes.

complex.experimental: This action’s RS command has not been verified yet. Transfer acknowledgment does not prove execution.
complex.empty: The controller did not send hourly values.
complex.readonly: Read only; writing this format over RS has not been verified.

mqtt.hint: MQTT/TCP on the local network. Actions such as calibration remain available only through the web confirmation dialog. Installer and service Discovery entities are disabled by default in HA.
mqtt.keep: Leave blank to keep saved password

results.action_delivered: Action delivered to controller; execution unverified
results.stale_metadata: Item metadata is older than 10 minutes
results.not_writable: This type or hidden item is not writable
results.invalid_integer: An integer protocol value is required
results.write_reconnected: Transfer cancelled on reconnect; no retry
results.write_timeout: Write not confirmed within 120 s; no automatic retry
